first_editorial_review.note: Gloria is not in appendix's printed morning recitation list; greater-catechism Q974 lists only through theological acts.
Do not insert Credo and theological acts as if they are in the 1905 Evening Appendix. Q984 broader daily practice separately recommends same morning prayers and examen.
Preserve complete combined morning prayer; no duplicate offerings/acts as separate additions.
The printed evening rubric explicitly adds examen followed by contrition; adjacent De profundis is titled for souls in Purgatory.
